virtual_user_drawer__allowed_anyone: Can use the parts of your app that anyone can.

virtual_user_drawer__goal_only: They only get the goal, never the steps, so they find their own way around, just like a real person.

virtual_users_screen__ask_turn_on: Ask Pikku to turn them on

virtual_users_screen__text: AI stand-ins for the people who use your app. Send one on a visit and they tell you where they got stuck.
